strings.sk_consent_popup_text:
Please accept our Terms of use and Privacy policy to proceed. By clicking Accept, you hereby confirm that:

1. You are above the age of 16.
2. You consent to the collection and processing of your personal data in accordance with Privacy policy.
3. You have read and accept Terms of Use.
strings.skad_popup_info_text: Ads on this app are what keep our service free. By allowing tracking, we’ll be able to better tailor ads served to you on this app. How it works? This app is supported by ads. To make these ads as relevant for each and every user we collect and share data with our ad partners. Also this data will be used to optimize the gameplay mechanics and performance. What data? We will not share any personal data, as we don’t collect it. By data we mean few data points of your device as for example your advertising identifier.
strings.skad_unity_popup_text: In order to keep this app free, you can let this app use information from our partners to better tailor ads to you on this app, by clicking "Allow tracking" on following popup.
strings.skad_unity_tut_popup_text: In order to make ads more relevant for our users, we use an advertising identifier. If you agree for us to use it, please allow tracking on the next screen.
